segments.en: With regard to the halakha governing extinguishing on a Festival, «Rav said: It is permitted to trim the end of a wick» that has become charcoal, so that it will burn better; this is not considered extinguishing.

moves.summary: Trimming a charred wick is permitted

positions.claim: trimming the charred end of a wick is permitted on a Festival
